lines.en: I crawl over the leaf.
I wriggle forward.
I inch along the leaf's edge.
I arch my back and reach.
I flip up from under the leaf.
I creep along the vein.
I poke my head out for tender leaves.

lines.zh: 我的脚一排排抓住叶面
lines.en: My row of feet grips the leaf.
I round the leaf tip slowly.
I crawl out into the light.
I crawl down the stem.
I cross the vein sideways.
I skirt the hole I bit.
I reach forward bit by bit.
I stop in the leaf's hollow.
I slowly adjust my course.
I lie on the leaf's heart.
I swell and slacken gently.
I hold a piece of leaf.
I am chewing slowly.
I rest without moving.
My colour is close to the leaf's.
I draw my head half back.
A patch of light falls on me.
I twist a little.
There is a fresh notch in the leaf.
I stretch out again.
I have no thought of moving.
I raise my face your way.
I have been here a long while.
This leaf still feeds me.
Do not knock the leaf off.
I shrink toward the vein.
Your shadow blocks my light.
I do not plan to leave.
My eyes never leave you.
Leave and I will eat again.
I press flat and stay still.
I curl into a ball.
I arch into a bow from the pain.
I drop onto the next leaf.
I cannot move.
I spit up green fluid.
I release my body segment by segment.
I grip the leaf.
I am still breathing.
I lie where I am.
I strain to shift once more.
Tender leaves are what I want.
One bite tells me: this is not leaf.
I crawl toward the shoot.
I take a test bite.
This one is too old.
I go back to my leaf.
I touch it and pull my stalks back.
I eat only this kind.
The leaves over there are tenderer.
I crawl over an inch at a time.
The knock makes me slide.
I grab the leaf quickly.
The leaf swings hard.
I nearly slip off the leaf.
I curl tight against the leaf vein.
I hump my way back onto the leaf.
You knocked off some leaf.
I press to the vein again.
That noise does not scare me.
I have not left this leaf yet.
Another crawls over.
It stops beside me.
We gnaw the leaf edge together.
It is a little bluer than I.
Our bodies lie side by side.
It rubs against me softly.
We crawl toward the leaf's heart.
We make no sound.
It climbs up first.
I trail along behind it.
I bite off a piece of leaf.
I chew for a long time.
I gulp this little piece down.
I gnaw one more mouthful.
I bit a hole clean through the leaf.

lines.zh: 我从叶洞外头看见光在晃。
lines.en: From beyond my hole, I see the light waver.
I move to a new leaf.
I cling to the new leaf's rim.
I crawl toward a fresh leaf.
I stay on this leaf.
I stop.
A shadow falls over me.
I pull my head back.
My body tightens.
I look for somewhere to hide.
I shift under the leaf.
I hear a sound.
I hold still.
I turn slowly that way.
Something is getting nearer.
I hide myself inside the leaf.
I stay pressed to the vein.
It has not found me out.
Moving shakes the leaf.
I wait for it to leave.
It has gone beneath the leaf.
I inch to the tip.
The light returns.
I hold on a little longer.
This colour of mine saves me.
All I can do is butt it.
I curl my blue body into a ball.
I squeeze deep into the fold.
Green fluid runs from my mouth.
I thrash my body.
I roll over under the leaf.
I hold the vein.
I have no strength to fight back.
I crawl slowly away.
I am hidden again.
I come out of the shell.
A damp line marks the leaf.
First I look up at the light.
I start on a tender leaf.
I crawl toward the vein.
I am still soft.
I rise up from beneath the leaf.
This tender leaf is mine.
I come out of the leaf gap.
I move into the light patch.
The heat near me stiffens my body.
I fall off the leaf.
Rain soaks through me and I grow heavy.
I was thrown right off the leaf.
A thorn runs through my back.
Spell light makes me curl tighter.
Off the leaf, I would starve.

lines.zh: 白光劈下来，我脚下的叶焦了。
lines.en: White light strikes; the leaf beneath me is scorched.

lines.zh: 我从叶背滑下去，抓不住了。
lines.en: I slip off the leaf's underside.
